title: fix(scenarios): skill-eval turns are spawned without the host's memory variables
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu1VhSQmxMmBJAWNw5MuyuHN)_

Fixes #37842

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 是什么：用户无感。技能评测和场景卡评测在项目容器里跑时，起的每个回合都不再读到本项目的记忆。
- 为什么：属于「评测可信」工作。之前两组（带技能、不带技能）都能读到项目记忆，不带技能的一组照着记忆答对，看起来和带技能一样好，技能的价值被藏住了。
- 出错会怎样：只影响内部评测怎么起提问进程；最坏是某个记忆变量没去干净，结果和以前一样，可直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/driver.ts`: new `CLAUDE_MEMORY_ENV = ['CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_PATH_OVERRIDE', 'CLAUDE_MEMORY_STORES']`, declared beside `API_BILLING_ENV` and `CLAUDE_EFFORT_ENV`, so the three lists of what a turn is spawned without live in one place.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/driver.ts`: `ClaudeCodeDriver.turnEnv`, the scenario runner's live driver, also deletes every name in `CLAUDE_MEMORY_ENV`, so its build (author) and ask turns are spawned without the host's memory variables too. Folded in at the seat's word after the first hand-off.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/run.ts`: `turnEnv` deletes every name in `CLAUDE_MEMORY_ENV`, after the billing and effort variables. `executeRound` already spawns every turn with `turnEnv()`, so both arms of every case get the scrubbed environment. The file header says so.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md` (skill-evals section): a new **Isolated from project memory** bullet says a round run inside a project container is isolated from that project's memory, which variables are removed and why, and that the scenario runner's build and ask turns are isolated too.
- `.changeset/37842-skill-evals-memory-isolated.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/scenarios` (the README ships in its `files[]`).

Measured before the change, in this container: both variables are set here (presence read only, values never printed). The card's evidence is the two rounds of PR #37841: with the variables inherited, all three no-skill answers to case 2 quoted a project memory note; with them removed, case 2 scored 3/3 with the skill and 0/3 without. No eval round was run for this PR.

## Tests

`packages/qa/scenarios/test/skill-evals/skill-evals.test.ts`:

- new block "a turn's environment": a host env carrying `PATH`, `HOME`, both billing variables, the effort variable and both memory variables yields exactly `{ PATH, HOME }`; every name of the three lists is absent; the memory list names both variables; the caller's env object is left as it was.
- the existing round test ("a round hands each turn its arm's directory…") now also stubs both memory variables in `process.env` and asserts that none of the four turns (two cases × two arms) receives either one. This pins the wiring through `executeRound`, not only the pure function.

`packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/units.test.ts` (the live driver against a stand-in `claude`): the stand-in's `ENV` turn now also answers which memory variables it was started with; a new test stubs both in `process.env`, runs one build turn and one ask turn through `makeDriver`, and asserts neither turn was started with either.

Ablation, one line at a time: with `for (const k of CLAUDE_MEMORY_ENV) delete out[k];` removed from the skill-evals `turnEnv`, 3 tests fail (the two new ones and the round test) and 37 pass; restored, 40/40. With the same line removed from `ClaudeCodeDriver.turnEnv`, the new `units.test.ts` test fails and 95 pass; restored, 96/96.

<details><summary>runs</summary>

Head ac1dd475.

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build` then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: 45 files, 1411 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --self-test`: 44 rows pass.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 65 derived (the same 65 as on the first head); 64 exit 0; 1 exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), so NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (its positive control is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Other memory-named variables the CLI reads (Claude Code 2.1.332's binary names `CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_MEMORY_DIR`, `CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_INDEX_CONTENT`, `CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_GUIDELINES`, `CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_EXTRA_GUIDELINES`, `CLAUDE_CODE_MEMORY_API_BASE_URL`, `CLAUDE_CODE_MEMORY_API_TOKEN`): not set in this container, not measured, not handled by this PR.
- The card's Expected section also asks that the round's record say the turn environment was scrubbed. The three Done-when items do not, and the dispatch scoped this PR to them, so `round.json` is unchanged; the README now states it for every round.

## Verification

Read first: `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/run.ts` (`turnEnv`), then `ClaudeCodeDriver.turnEnv` in `src/runner/driver.ts`, then the two new test spots.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/skill-evals/skill-evals.test.ts test/runner/units.test.ts` prints 136 passed.
